ck: trEkunya-visaya trEkunyan sansaro visaya prakasayitavya yesan te veta trEkunya-visaya tvan tu nistrEkunyo pava arcuna, niskano pava ity arta nirtvantva suka-tuka-hetu sa-pratipaksO patartO tvantva-sapta-vacyO tata nirkata nirtvantvo pava nitya-satva-sta sata satva-kunasrito pava tata niryoka-kseno nupatasya upatanan yoka, upatasya raksanan ksena, yoka-ksena-pratanasya sreyasi pravrtir tuskara ity ata niryoka-kseno pava atnavan apranatas ca pava esa tava upatesa sva-tarnan anutistata

pk: yoginan api sarvesan rudradityadi-Dyana-paranan naDye nad-gatena nayi vasudeve sanahitenantaratnananta-karanena sradDavan sradaDana san Bajate sevate yo nan, sa ne nana yuktatano tisayena yukto nato Bipreta iti iti srinat-paranahansa-parivrajakacaryasya sri-govinda-Bagavat-pujya-pada- sisyasya srinac-Cankara-Bagavata krta srinad-Bagavad-gita-Basye saswo Dyaya 6 _ Bg 7 aTa jnana-vijnana-yogaKya saptano Dyaya (sankara-Basya) yoginan api sarvesan nad-gatenantaratnana sradDavanBajate yo nan sa ne yuktatano nata [gita 6.47] iti prasna-bijan upanyasya, svayan eva idrsan nadiyan tatvan, evan nad-gatantar-atna syad ity etat vivaksu sri-Bagavan uvaca - nay asaktanana parTa yogan yunjan nadasraya asansayan sanagran nan yaTa jnasyasi tac Crnu
ck: yokinan api sarvesan rutratityati-tyana-paranan natye nat-katena nayi vasuteve sanahitenantaratnananta-karanena sratavan sratatana san pacate sevate yo nan, sa ne nana yuktatano tisayena yukto nato pipreta iti iti srinat-paranahansa-parivracakacaryasya sri-kovinta-pakavat-pucya-pata- sisyasya srinac-cankara-pakavata krta srinat-pakavat-kita-pasye sasto tyaya 6 _ pk 7 ata cnana-vicnana-yokakya saptano tyaya (sankara-pasya) yokinan api sarvesan nat-katenantaratnana sratavanpacate yo nan sa ne yuktatano nata [kita 6.47] iti prasna-pican upanyasya, svayan eva itrsan natiyan tatvan, evan nat-katantar-atna syat ity etat vivaksu sri-pakavan uvaca - nay asaktanana parta yokan yuncan natasraya asansayan sanakran nan yata cnasyasi tac crnu
s: योगिनाम् अपि सर्वेषां रूद्रादित्यादि-ध्यान-पराणां मध्ये मद्-गतेन मयि वासुदेवे समाहितेनान्तरात्मनान्तः-करणेन श्रद्धावान् श्रद्दधानः सन् भजते

s: ज्ञानं ते तुभ्यम् अहं स-विज्ञानं विज्ञान-सहितं स्वानुभव-युक्तम् इदं वक्ष्यामि कथयिष्याम्य् अशेषतः कार्त्स्न्येन तज् ज्ञानं विवक्षितं स्तौति

ck: iti srinat-paranahansa-parivracakacaryasya sri-kovinta-pakavat-pucya-pata- sisyasya srinac-cankara-pakavata krtO srinat-pakavat-kita-pasye prahnaksara-nirteso nana astano tyaya 8 _ pk 9 ata raca-vitya-raca-kuhya-yoko nana navano tyaya (sankara-pasya) astane naty-ati-tvarena tarana-yoka sakuna ukta tasya ca palan akny-arcir-ati-kranena kalantare prahna-prapti-laksanan evanavrti-rupan nirtistan tatranenEva prakarena noksa-prapti-palan atikanyate, nanyata iti tat asanka-vyavivartayisaya sri-pakavan uvaca - itan tu te kuhyatanan pravaksyany anasuyave cnanan vicnana-sahitan yac cnatva noksyase supat

pk: raja-vidya vidyanan raja, dipty-atisayavatvat dipyate hiyan atisayena brahna-vidya sarva-vidyanan taTa raja-guhyan guhyanan raja pavitran pavanan idan utanan sarvesan pavananan sudDi-karanan brahna-jnanan utkrswatanan aneka-jana-sahasra-sancitan api DarnaDarnadi sa-nulan karna ksana-natrad eva Basnikarotity ata kin tasya pavanatvan vaktavyan ? kin ca - pratyaksavaganan pratyaksena suKader ivavagano yasya tat pratyaksavaganan aneka-gunavato pi Darna-virudDatvan drswan, na taTatna-jnanan Darna-viroDi, kintu Darnyan Darnad anapetan evan api, syad duKa-sanpadyan ity ata aha - susuKan kartun, yaTa ratna-viveka-vijnanan tatralpayasanan anyesan karnanan suKa-sanpadyanan alpa-Palatvan duskaranan ca naha-Palatvan drswan iti, idan tu suKa-sanpadyatvat Pala-ksayat vyetiti prapte, aha - avyayan iti nasya Palata karnavat vyayo stity avyayan ata sradDeyan atna-jnanan
ck: raca-vitya vityanan raca, tipty-atisayavatvat tipyate hiyan atisayena prahna-vitya sarva-vityanan tata raca-kuhyan kuhyanan raca pavitran pavanan itan utanan sarvesan pavananan suti-karanan prahna-cnanan utkrstatanan aneka-cana-sahasra-sancitan api tarnatarnati sa-nulan karna ksana-natrat eva pasnikarotity ata kin tasya pavanatvan vaktavyan ? kin ca - pratyaksavakanan pratyaksena sukater ivavakano yasya tat pratyaksavakanan aneka-kunavato pi tarna-virutatvan trstan, na tatatna-cnanan tarna-viroti, kintu tarnyan tarnat anapetan evan api, syat tuka-sanpatyan ity ata aha - susukan kartun, yata ratna-viveka-vicnanan tatralpayasanan anyesan karnanan suka-sanpatyanan alpa-palatvan tuskaranan ca naha-palatvan trstan iti, itan tu suka-sanpatyatvat pala-ksayat vyetiti prapte, aha - avyayan iti nasya palata karnavat vyayo stity avyayan ata srateyan atna-cnanan
s: राज-विद्या विद्यानां राजा, दीप्त्य्-अतिशयवत्त्वात् दीप्यते हीयम् अतिशयेन ब्रह्म-विद्या सर्व-विद्यानाम् तथा राज-गुह्यं गुह्यानां राजा पवित्रं

ck: iti srinat-paranahansa-parivracakacaryasya sri-kovinta-pakavat-pucya-pata- sisyasya srinac-cankara-pakavata krtO srinat-pakavat-kita-pasye tvataso tyaya _ pk 13 [*note: nunperink op tis atyaya out op tune tit stantart etitions ant propaply tepective; "13.3" nisink!] ata ksetra-ksetracna-yoko nana trayotaso tyaya (sri-sankaracarya-pakavat-pata-krta-pasyan) saptane tyaye sucite tve prakrti isvarasya trikunatnikastata pinapara sansara-hetutvat, para canya civa-puta ksetracna-laksanesvaratnika yapyan prakrtipyan isvaro cakat-utpati-stiti-laya-hetutvan pratipatyate tatra ksetra-ksetracna-laksana-prakrti-tvaya-nirupana-tvarena tatvata isvarasya tatva-nirtaranartan ksetratyaya arapyate atitanantaratyaye ca atvesta sarva-putanan [kita 12.13] ity atina yavat-atyaya-parisanaptis tavat tatva-cnaninan sanyasinan nista yata te vartanta ity etat uktan kena punas te tatva-cnanena yukta yatokta-tarnacaranat pakavata priya pavanty evan artas cayan atyaya arapyate prakrtis ca trikunatnika sarva-karya-karana-visayakarena parinata purusasya pokapavarkarta-kartavyataya tehentriyatyakarena sanhanyate so yan sankata itan sariran tat etat pakavan uvaca - itan sariran kOnteya ksetran ity apitiyate etat yo veti tan prahu ksetracna iti tat-vita

sva-vrta-sTo na jayate ity aBipraya nanu, yady api jnanotpaty-anantaran punar-janaBava ukta, taTapi prag jnanotpate krtanan karnanan utara-kala-Bavinan ca yani catikrantaneka-jana-krtani tesan ca Palan adatva naso na yukta iti syus trini janani krta-vipranaso hi na yukta iti, yaTa Pale pravrtanan arabDa-jananan karnanan na ca karnanan viseso vaganyate tasnat tri-prakarany api karnani trini janany araBeran sanhatani va sarvany ekan janaraBeran anyaTa krta-vinase sati sarvatranasvasa-prasanga, sastranarTakyan ca syat ity ata idan ayuktan uktan na sa Buyo Bijayate iti na ksiyante casya karnani [nunqu 2.2.8], brahna veda brahnEva Bavati [nunqu 3.2.9], tasya tavad eva ciran [Cau 6.14.2], isika-tulavat sarvani karnani praduyante [Cau 5.24.3] ity adi-sruti-sateBya ukto vidusa sarva-karna-daha ihapi cokto yaTEDansi [gita 4.37] ity adina sarva-karna-daha vaksyati copapates ca avidya-kana-klesa-bija-ninitani hi karnani janantarankuran araBante ihapi ca sahankaraBisanDini karnani PalaranBakani, netaraniti tatra tatra Bagavatoktan bijany agny-upadagDani na rohanti yaTa puna jnana-dagDEs taTa klesEr natna sanpadyate puna [nB 3.20.10] iti ca astu tavaj jnanotpaty-utara-kala-krtanan karnanan jnanena daha, jnana-saha-Bavitvat na tv iha janani jnanotpate prak krtanan karnanan atita-jana-krtanan ca daho yukta na sarva-karnaniti visesanat jnanotara-kala-Bavinan eva sarva-karnanan iti cet, na sankoce karananupapate yat tuktan yaTa vartanana-janaranBakani karnani na ksiyante Pala-danaya pravrtany eva saty api jnane, taTanarabDa-Palanan api karnanan ksayo na yukta iti, tad asat kaTan ? tesan nuktesuvat pravrta-Palatvat yaTa purvan laksya-veDaya nukta isu Danuso laksya-veDotara-kalan api arabDa-vega-ksayat patanenEva nivartate, evan sariraranBakan karna sarira-sTiti-prayojane nivrte pi, a sanskara-vega-ksayat purvavat vartata eva yaTa sa eva isu pravrti-ninitanarabDa-vegas tv anukto Danusi prayukto pi upasanhriyate, taTanarabDa-Palani karnani svasraya-sTany eva jnanena nirbiji-kriyanta iti patite snin vidvac-Carire na sa Buyo Bijayate iti yuktan evoktan iti sidDan
